norwood-scales.description: Hair loss severity grading (Norwood scale stages 1-6)

assets.label: Stage-3
assets.clinicalContext: Moderate frontotemporal recession, early crown involvement

assets.label: Stage-4
assets.clinicalContext: Significant recession at vertex and frontal area

assets.label: Stage-5
assets.clinicalContext: Extensive baldness with reduced separation band

scalp-conditions.description: Scalp health assessment visuals - inflammation, dandruff, irritation

assets.label: Clear Scalp
assets.clinicalContext: Healthy scalp, no visible inflammation or flaking

assets.label: Mild Dandruff
assets.clinicalContext: Dry scalp with light flaking, minor irritation

assets.label: Severe Dandruff
assets.clinicalContext: Oily or dry scalp with heavy flaking

assets.label: Itchy/Inflamed Scalp
assets.clinicalContext: Redness, irritation, itching, possible seborrheic dermatitis

assets.label: Scalp Infection
assets.clinicalContext: Boils, pimples, pustules, fungal/bacterial infection signs

hair-patterns.description: Hair loss pattern and shedding visuals for severity assessment

assets.label: 20-50 Strands
assets.clinicalContext: Normal daily shedding range, healthy follicle cycle

assets.label: 50-100 Strands
assets.clinicalContext: Noticeable shedding, early telogen effluvium indicators

assets.label: 100+ Strands
assets.clinicalContext: Severe shedding, significant hair loss per day

assets.label: Thinning Pattern
assets.clinicalContext: Overall hair density reduction without visible shedding

assets.label: Widening Parting
assets.clinicalContext: Visible widening of part line, scalp visibility increase

assets.label: Circular Patch
assets.clinicalContext: Alopecia areata - circular patch of complete hair loss

assets.label: Heavy Hair Fall
assets.clinicalContext: Diffuse thinning across scalp, multiple affected areas
